method: Deep-research replay derived from the frozen 2021Q1 event set. Company forecasts and deterministic pre-cutoff regimes are cutoff-bounded; current-model/search leakage remains uncontrolled.
caveats: Current model weights may encode later outcomes.
No post-cutoff selected-stock returns are opened before deep memos lock.
Company evidence after each memo cutoff is excluded even if it later confirms the thesis.
equityReturnArchetype is descriptive only and does not alter V1.2 gates.
